parent_objective: Optimize lawful Magmaw 10N bots across every DPS, tank and healer against matched WCL; use exact WoWSims dummy evidence for class diagnosis.
objective: Extend the existing Blood decision observation so the next matched Magmaw run can join valid-valid Death Strike selections to exact rune-slot cooldown state and the next legal strike without changing gameplay.
hypothesis: The v25 Blood profile correctly performs equal-bucket Death Strike and Heart Strike arbitration, but the retained run cannot prove or disprove downstream rune/cadence loss because the observation records only aggregate ready-rune counts. Recording each rune slot's base/current type, cooldown fraction, regeneration rate, and estimated ready timestamp at every relevant candidate evaluation will make the suspected edge auditable across successive native decisions. No Blood priority, spell, rune-legality, mitigation, movement, encounter, or reference repair is authorized by this plan.
observations: Actor 30002 selected Death Strike over valid Heart Strike in seven retained rows at 87.807%-100% health, including one full-health zero-effective-heal row, but the retained data lacks slot-level rune spend and ready-time joins.
The retained direct-damage outage from t+36.501 to t+42.036 is attributed to hazard-owned parasite_contact_evade movement and remains separate from Blood action arbitration.

The independent read-only review found no authorized role-policy repair: a high-health Death Strike must first be joined to a delayed or missing later legal strike before any threshold or ordering change.
Existing BotBloodDecisionObservation data preserves aggregate counts and candidate scores, so the smallest safe change is additive per-slot telemetry in that helper plus its focused fixture.

Do not change parasite-contact movement, encounter scripts, route manifests, runtime profiles, roster, WCL denominators, simulator references, gear, stats, gems, reforges, or consumables.

Do not modify files outside the bounded owned set.

The observation is attached only to relevant Blood Death Knight selections as before, and the additive fields do not affect candidate validity, scoring, selection, or action execution.

The focused fixture compiles with warnings-as-errors and asserts slot identity, cooldown, regeneration, estimated ready time, aggregate-count preservation, non-Blood rejection, and the existing candidate fields.
The source remains below the repository's 1,000-line C/C++ guard and the focused test plus existing Blood policy regression pass.

An independent reviewer approves the exact two-file observation-only delta, then a clean policy-bound build and completion-watchdog Magmaw 10N run record the enriched Blood observations. This work may inform the next diagnosis but cannot by itself accept actor_30002, performance, Magmaw 10N, or the parent objective.
acceptance_claim: Plan only. This receipt claims an observation-gap repair path and no gameplay, build, live, actor, performance, raid-clear, publication, or parent acceptance.
